implementation: AnalysisKey fixes canonical tree data, resolved Profile identity, concrete per-alias execution identities and typed analysis conditions/effective Limits. Sources, URI, content, embedded environments, provider/resource selections and arena execution layout participate in those identities.

Explicit prepared requests validate actual inputs and compute keys. Their borrowed typed proof fixes the tree/profile for execution; the actual execution Budget must match the effective limits. No raw key or requested limits grants host permission.

Real BindingRequest CBOR decode works with a fresh receiver lacking the original request/store. It verifies the complete received tree and recalculates the key; preparing again rejects subsequent changes. Bound replies retain every ordinary result branch and typed access failures.

Keyed for_source checks expected current key, exact source revision/digest and completion before exposing the native analysis proof. Raw reply decoding remains structural data, not execution provenance.

Core BundleMappings provides charged borrowed canonical DFS/node indices. Binding initialization uses that same order for roots/namespaces/Origins, canonical selection order and sorted borrowed source references. Normal analyze does not encode/decode or clone the whole tree.

Seven generic type annotations accidentally interpreted as HTML were corrected to inline code in reader/Grammar/review Markdown. The current documentation audit showed existing table/list/link/code gaps remain relevant to the later Doc model.
